description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for the account that owns the API key. Nothing is charged until the checkout is completed in a browser.

credit_shortfall.description: Credits a blocked request is missing, e.g. `credit_shortfall` from a 402 response. The checkout starts with enough packs to cover it. Defaults to one pack.

pack_count.description: Number of credit packs the checkout starts with. Takes priority over `credit_shortfall`.

type.description: What to buy. `credit_pack` is a one-time credit purchase.

name: checkout_create

checkout_url.description: Open in a browser to complete the purchase.

title: Create checkout
